🌟 MetaRadar | Kotlin
🎯 Primary Use Case: Monitoring and analyzing the Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) environment to identify trackable devices and understand device privacy features.
✨ Key Features: • Scan, analyze and track Bluetooth devices around • Create flexible filters for the radar • Deep analysis of scanned BLE devices via GATT services • GATT services Explorer • Define device type by metadata
📖 Summary: MetaRadar is an Android application designed for monitoring and analyzing Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) environments. It allows users to discover, track, and filter BLE devices, providing insights into their privacy-preserving capabilities and potential for tracking.
